Overview

Corpus Christi is a city in TX with a population of 317,863. Texas beach town with Gulf Coast living, no state income tax, and naval aviation. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9b growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing.
